text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the City of Toronto capital spending for the six month period ended June 30, 2020, as well as projected expenditures to December 31, 2020. Furthermore, this report seeks Council's approval for in-year budget adjustments to the 2020 Approved Capital Budget and Plan that have no impact on 2020 approved debt. As illustrated in Table 1 below, City's 2020 capital expenditure was $1.340 billion or 28.9% of the 2020 capital budget of $4.637 billion for the period ended June 30, 2020 and is projecting to expend $3.934 billion or 84.8% by December 31, 2020.
